bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Figure 6: the analysis pipeline as typed data-operation nodes. read the raw trials; filter invalid trials; map each trial to derived measures; branch at an exclusive gateway; reduce to per-run summaries then to group statistics; and render and write, after a visible manual outlier review. A BDM trials dataset feeds Read; a results dataset receives Render and write.
bpmn2:process.name: Analysis pipeline
